name: Manager Review — Final approve counted items
description: Manager logs in with test_manager, selects TS-ITEM-001 in manager review, and executes final approval.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_manager into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Locate the item TS-ITEM-001 in the manager review list and select its checkbox
Click the final approve button labelled تایید نهایی موارد انتخابی in the action bar
Click the confirm button in the confirmation dialog
Verify that the item TS-ITEM-001 is approved and no longer in pending manager review
